title: CDN spike part 1: host routing function with a KeyValueStore, and whether a purge can be limited to one tenant
description:
Outcome: Throwaway CDK stack in the sandbox account: one distribution, one bucket with sites/alpha and sites/beta, a viewer-request CloudFront Function mapping Host to prefix via a KeyValueStore. Measure with x-cache whether invalidating '/about/' (and '/sites/alpha/about/') purges only alpha's copy. This decides the freshness design for the shared stack. Size: one agent session. Worktree Papyrus-worktrees/ (beside the Papyrus checkout) spike-shared-edge-1, branch feature/<this issue id>-spike-shared-edge-1 from origin/develop (spikes: branch spike/<this issue id>-spike-shared-edge-1, sandbox only, no PR needed beyond notes).

Touches (verified at origin/develop 23fabe1d): new throwaway stack; reads amplify/publication/redirect-and-index.js and src/papyrus_content/edge_invalidation.py.

Acceptance (Gherkin feature file: features_backend/shared-edge-spike.feature):
Scenario: Purging alpha's page leaves beta's cached
    Given both tenants' /about/ are cached
    When alpha's /about/ is purged
    Then beta's next request is a cache hit

Dependencies: blocked by nothing. Blocks nothing in this plan yet. (Also recorded as kbs dependencies.)
Implements or extends: -.

Testing: curl with x-cache headers; findings on this issue; destroy the stack afterwards.
Rollout: Merge to develop by PR when green (not a release; the newsroom automation session owns releases). Record branch, PR and verification on this issue.
Risk and mitigation: Low; scoped to one session.

Releasable on its own: yes.
DynamoDB index: none.
AppSync authorisation: unchanged.
Design note: docs/plans/multi-tenant-architecture.md (PR on branch docs/multi-tenant-architecture).
